### 2026-10-09 — P01 fail-first/runtime checkpoint

Pinned OTP public `getopt(socket, {:socket, :peercred})` fails with invalid socket option. The documented `getopt_native(socket, {:socket, 17}, 12)` returns Linux SO_PEERCRED matching the independently known process PID/UID/GID. Log: `test/reports/foundation/p01-credential-probe.log`. Public `getopt(socket, {:otp, :fd})` works. OTP socket.open accepts socket descriptors only, not arbitrary pipe/file descriptors; a narrow native resource boundary is being implemented outside ex_d_bus.

New independent pipe/file/socket resource regressions: **3 tests, 3 expected failures** before the resource adapter exists (`p01-resources-red.log`). These are red evidence, not passed gates. P01 incomplete; full FD, release-launcher, multi-UID, and VM qualification NOT RUN.
